text: At its meeting held April 22 and 23, 2026, City Council considered item CA34.3 - Appointment of a Public Member to the Exhibition Place Board, and appointed Bhutila Karpoche to the Exhibition Place Board of Governors for a term of office starting April 24, 2026 and ending March 28, 2030, and until a successor is appointed. As part of this process, Howard Lichtman’s term of office on the Board came to an end effective April 23, 2026.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place received the item for information.
